risk_note: RV2 (orders; BR-FUND-22 with BR-CALC-02). The platform-restore commission trigger now uses the effective commission: settle_commission_fen when non-null, otherwise est_commission_fen (08 BR-CALC-02: once settle is non-null, estimate changes are archived only). It fires when the effective commission moves from null / <=0 to >0, independent of platform_status; expected_fen = the new effective commission. This fixes the B1-08zc money S2 (a SETTLED clawed-back order with settle 0 whose estimate alone moved 0 -> >0 registered a false diff) without missing PDD orders, whose adapter always leaves settle null. P9 status trigger, eligibility branches, dedupe keys and alerts are unchanged; B1-08zc frozen rule tests untouched. Rule tests by a fresh independent Claude in three rounds (spec-test r1 fail S1 -> round 2; money r1 found the brief's SETTLED-only wording wrong for null settle -> round 3 rewrote this task's own unmerged tests to the effective-commission rule; r3 pass). Test-machine verify:fast passed on 14fbc754; full verify hits the 3600 s container limit (exit 124) and per D10-319 the CI verify-int decides. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).

reviews.note: fresh independent Claude via claude-run.sh (Codex unavailable until 11-02). r1 fail (S1x2: null settle must fall back to the estimate per BR-CALC-02; the tests pinned the defect) -> brief corrected, tests and implementation redone; r2 pass with no in-scope findings, one out-of-scope S2 (P9 amount for PDD should also use the effective commission) recorded as a follow-up

spec_test_review.note: rule tests by a fresh independent Claude; spec-test r1 fail (no same-report RECEIVED -> SETTLED case), r2 pass, round 3 after the money correction, r3 pass (one S2 on judging settle and estimate separately, handled in the implementation); test machine showed 9, 17 and 18 red tests failing for the right reason
